response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT c.ID, c.examination_count, CAST(c.examination_count AS REAL) / t.total_examinations AS share_of_total FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_examinations FROM Examination) AS t), compared AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, share_of_total, share_of_total - AVG(share_of_total) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM shares) SELECT ID, examination_count, share_of_total, above_average_share FROM compared WHERE above_average_share > 0 ORDER BY above_average_share DESC, ID LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average is across patient IDs appearing in Examination. Examinations with a NULL ID remain in the total but are not assigned to a patient.

alternatives.interpretation: Average the shares across every ID in Patient, including patients with no examinations.
alternatives.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT p.ID, COUNT(e.ID) AS examination_count FROM Patient AS p LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID), shares AS (SELECT c.ID, c.examination_count, CAST(c.examination_count AS REAL) / t.total_examinations AS share_of_total FROM counts AS c CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_examinations FROM Examination) AS t), compared AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, share_of_total, share_of_total - AVG(share_of_total) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM shares) SELECT ID, examination_count, share_of_total, above_average_share FROM compared WHERE above_average_share > 0 ORDER BY above_average_share DESC, ID LIMIT 10
